::: {.objectives}
#### Learning objectives

* Explain how supervised classifiers predict localisation by comparing unknown proteins' correlation profiles with marker profiles, and why proteins can only be assigned to classes present in the training data.
* Tune SVM hyperparameters (`sigma`, `cost`) by cross-validation (`svmOptimisation`), with class weights to handle unequal class sizes, and judge performance by F1 scores (`getF1Scores`, `f1Count`, `getParams`).
* Classify proteins with an SVM (`svmClassification`) and set organelle-specific score thresholds (`orgQuants`, `getPredictions`).
* Train and apply the Bayesian TAGM-MAP model (`tagmMapTrain`, `tagmMapPredict`), check its convergence, and threshold predictions on combined localisation and outlier probabilities.
* Describe how TAGM-MCMC differs from TAGM-MAP, and check MCMC convergence with trace and density plots and the Gelman–Rubin diagnostic, removing and pooling chains as needed.
* Use TAGM-MCMC posterior distributions and Shannon entropy to find proteins with uncertain or multiple localisations.
:::
